capabilities: move the active tab to the left or right tab group
split off a new group when none exists on that side
preserve tab focus and history during the move
assign custom hotkeys to the move commands
extras: Desktop only; uses internal Obsidian workspace methods because there is no public API for moving tabs between groups, so a future Obsidian update may break it (tested on Obsidian 1.13.7). Sets no default hotkeys; the README warns that Ctrl+Alt+arrow keys conflict with default navigate back/forward bindings on Windows and Linux.
problem: Obsidian's built-in split commands open a copy of the note in a new pane, and moving a tab between groups otherwise requires dragging with the mouse.
summary: Keyboard-command tool that moves the active tab into the tab group on its left or right, splitting off a new group if none exists.
